record.title: Freeze the RF comparison protocol and decide execution readiness
record.intent: Bind the experiment to actual equipment, claim scope and authorized physical transitions before data collection.
requirements: Review source and pilot evidence against the selected question. Freeze hypotheses, frequency points, repeats, reference/normalization, estimator, sensitivity, uncertainty and stop criteria before comparison data.

Pin software arms with actual hash/policy observations, matched acquisition conditions, calibration/option preservation, transition/reboot and rollback steps, source/drift checks and raw-evidence destinations.

Use stock/derived/stock by default, documenting any justified change. Account for the last recorded derived starting state and explicitly choose the final software/bench state; no silent reapplication after rollback.

Bind applicable operator authorization to the exact physical procedure. Check capture/export/cleanup readiness. Neither software FULL selection nor source setpoint proves the required policy or delivered amplitude.

Close only on a supported go decision. On hold/no-go retain this task open, record the missing condition and admit a bounded remedy through normal planning and prerequisite revision; do not release acquisition on a failed gate.
Commit and push the frozen protocol and decision before acquisition. A material change after this gate requires reconciliation and a new or revised experiment identity.
acceptance: A frozen evidence-backed protocol, resolved readiness conditions and applicable authorization support one bounded physical comparison.

review.rationale: Reviewed the explicit output-layout correction after the preserved pre-mutation local-directory failure. Four empty SCPI directories are required; future reader phase directories stay absent. Controller, numerical, thermal, preservation and no-retry gates remain unchanged; only independently verified successor stock can release execution. This records semantic dependency currency only.
